turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?
Our return and refund policy is designed to ensure a smooth process for you. Here are the key details:
Return Window: You have 21 days from the date of delivery to return your items.
Condition of Items: Items must be in their original condition – unworn, unwashed, and with tags still attached. Footwear should not have been worn outdoors.
Return Process: Once you’ve registered your return through our returns portal, we ask that the items are posted back to us within 5 days.
In-Store Purchases: If your purchase was made in one of our physical stores, returns must be completed in-store within the same 21-day window.
Refund Timeline: Once your return arrives at our warehouse, we aim to process it within 10 days. After approval, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. You’ll receive an email confirmation once the refund is processed.
Gift Cards: Refunds for purchases made with a gift card will be issued back to the same gift card. For split payments, refunds will first be applied to the gift card portion.
Exchanges: If you’ve requested an exchange but the item is no longer available, a refund will be issued instead, and you’ll be notified by email.
Hygiene Items: Boxers can only be returned or exchanged if they are unworn, unwashed, and in their original packaging with seals intact.
Please ensure your parcel is securely packaged to avoid damage in transit, and retain proof of postage until your return is processed. For full details, you can view our returns policy here.
If you have any further questions, feel free to ask!
